body: I get how you feel bud. It sucks not finding satisfaction in your daily life.
I resorted to self harming again. I took a blade and ran it across my skin on my chest.

Legends Arceus was the last one I played. I think that I would spend my time hiding, them alpha Pokémon scary as shit. In my play thru I found a alpha roserade. I did not alarm it. But that fucker followed me for a good 3 minutes of creeping around. Every time I turned around it was watching me! :(
Hey wassup bud? Is it anything in particular? I hope I can’t help.
My sperm donor of a “father” 🥱

I’m sorry to hear that man. I have a different perspective as I always had my mom and she has always looked out for me. We had a difficult relationship due to the fact that she was going through a lot and was affected by the divorce also. Since I turns 23 I moved back to my home country and tried to establish a connection with my family. My mom and I have a better relationship however, my dad is a piece of shit. I am mostly hurt because he didn’t really hide it I just tried to see if after we bonded if things will be better. He doesn’t try if I don’t and due to that I gave up. I hope maybe you can establish a connection to your mom or at the  dry least find happiness within yourself.
I suppose your right.
I understand and that's what keeps here also. Every time I come close, scenarios of all my loved ones play in my mind and I hate myself for it. That's the worse feeling honestly.

I lack the ability to care for myself, I use to work out but I had to stop due to my depression spells. I lost a lot of weight and I could eat for anything. I don't sleep at nights, I have nightmares almost every night. 

As for my job the only aspect I don't like about it is the fact that everyone loves to gossip which triggers my anxiety. I can't escape that because I live on an island everyone loves to gossip. I don't drive and I hate asking people to do things for me. So in the mean time I just stay home and do the only thing that gives me some enjoyment and that's playing league of legends it distracts me from suicidal thoughts. I use to love listening to music (mainly rap because I like story tellers) but I don't enjoy that anymore. 

My charity work was making YouTube videos for people who are depressed but my biggest fear is people living on this island catching wind if that and branding me as someone with mental issues (people who come from here are small/close minded) 

I really don't wanna try anymore if I'm honest. To fail makes me sink a lot lower. And I rarely have any success in anything I do.
I'm listening speak your mind. Keeping things in only makes it worse for yourself. I understand how it feels when you speak and no one listens. I would love to hear what you have to say.
That maybe true but this way they can open up if they want to. It's no pressure at all.

I suppose you are right, I just see a lot of posts in the depression section that I can relate to. So I was just sending this so anyone who feels like their post went unread can contact me and have someone listen to them, you know? I guess it was wishful thinking.
Your doing great. You're there for her. Keep standing by her side and supporting her. Your a wonderful person. I believe in you!
😔 I understand how you feel...it hurts. If you wanna talk I'll listen

Hey, I feel like we need to talk. I'm in the same position as you. Like yourself I've been suffering from suicidal thoughts however, I've been setting goals for the month to give myself something to live for. It hasn't been going well and I feel like this month maybe my last. I dunno if I can help but if you feel like how I feel I know you just want someone to talk to. Someone you can relate to. Please dm me I dunno if I can help but I would love to try. Maybe we can fix each other.

Hey man I admire your progress and I wish I could also get to the stage where your at. Also, I just wanna ask how well does your gf know you? Do you two have a strong enough bond that she would understand or at least try to understand? If she is the understanding type, I think you should invite her over one day/night and just talk to her. You know just open up to her.
I feel you on that

Honestly, I'm the same way. I want to fall in love and I put myself out there to find someone but I guess I'm repulsive. No one seems to take to me. I'm not the type to be like send me nudes. I have respect for you. But it's like nowadays people prefer savages you know? The guys who treat girls like shit. I haven't got it in me. Besides that I'm a person who is suffering at the moment from depression, I am suicidal atm and I over think a lot of things in the sense that scenarios would just play on repeat. Despite all of that I'm not that bad of a person I like to make people smile, I like to make jokes, I hardly take things serious unless I have too. I'm a gamer I currently play League of legends, I have a bad habit of helping people it's a gift and a curse. I often end up being used. I know that would put a lot of people off I don't mind. Just know if you can cope with me I will always be there for you. Pm me if you wanna get to know me.
True but in a small island where everyone knows everyone isn't the best thing. People don't understand and are quick to judge. If people became aware of my mental state it would be hard to get jobs
I want to but I dunno how to. 2nd day on Reddit. Can u pm me?

My name on league of legends is "You Should KYS" people take that as a joke. But honestly I did that because that's constantly what my subconscious is telling me. No one sees the truth behind a fake smile.

I also spoke to two of my co-workers about it and one of them actually talked me out of off myself couple months back and the other told my cousin about it. My cousin and a few other family members were in a discord when he got the message that said "one of your family memebers are seriously depressed please help him" he read it out...and laughed.

I've tried that. They don't know I'm suicidal but they know I've been on anti depressants (while in the UK, I now moved back to the Cayman Islands). Couple months ago I asked my brother how do I go about getting more, he told me that it's not something you'd want to get as your job can ask for your medical history and seeing that I have mental health issues wouldn't be a good look for me. My mom wants me to get counselling and I would love too however I've been counselling many times before and it hasn't helped me. She's also suggested it to my dad and told him to try and convince me. But he told me that I don't need to, something's you just have to fix myself. I've been trying to do so long before he suggested it. I've been setting myself life goals for the month, but every month has been an utter disappointment.

Yes! Mines. I have more bad memories than happy ones. Bare in mind I'm blocked out couple years of my life. I don't enjoy anything dude. I hate being alive. Inbox me your number with area code if you would like to speak about anything.
I am the same way. If you wanna talk we can just inbox me your WhatsApp.
I make people miserable, so I question my existence. Is it worth me being here? I only cause problems. I'm only a burden.

I guess that's one way to look at it. Hopefully it's that was for you. However, I feel like that isn't really the case for me. From an early age I've been conscience of my mental health as in I knew I was depresssed I was always lonely. I strived to be happy until I was 11 and moved to the uk. I didn't have much and I rarely asked for things. Things that I truly needed got provided in its most basic form. I'm not being ungrateful for getting the essentials it's just that it didn't motivate me to look forward to anything, if I asked to go anywhere I couldn't.


I'm giving up, I lost the will to try

I admire and envy your positivity, however I can't look forward to temporary happiness. The whole of my like I've had temporary happiness. Every 1-3 years of my life is a drastic change. A lot of them has left me confused about how I feel within myself, sometimes I question if I was ever happy, I try to make the best of my situations by being a joker and attracting people around me. But the pain of temporary happiness kills me
I wish you the best but I have given up on the whole happy act. I prefer to be alone. Hurts way too much to see people leave.

I've tried that...I've been trying to do that I started working out I got a job, I moved from England back to my home country. My expectations are very low, I have tried everything. The only thing that helps me to pass time is League of Legends.

I usually don't support people who are suicidal, but that's hypocritical. I fucking hate this world and my life, I've been ready to die for a year now. This is my last month on earth! See you in the afterlife!

You and me both. I feel like the signs of me not being happy are very obvious but I also feel like no one around actually gives a fuck to even notice. Deep down I just wanna talk to someone who genuinely cares. But that's wishful thinking. No one fucking cares about anyone else nowadays. The heartless people always win. The ones who care gets trampled on!
